purpose: Canonical qualification cases for Nixward's evidence-bound system-change lifecycle. These cases are not evidence that automated tests exist or pass.

cases.scenario: Modify the command or configuration patch after detached approval is issued.

coverage.known_gap: No end-to-end negative test tampers with a serialized approved plan and observes the actual mutation boundary refusing it.

cases.scenario: Replay a valid authorization against a different machine identity.

coverage.known_gap: Plan identity includes machine binding, but a cross-host authorization attempt has no dedicated execution-boundary negative test.

cases.scenario: Submit an expired, future-dated, malformed-freshness, or zero-nonce change plan.

coverage.known_gap: The suite does not yet exercise every malformed nonce/freshness/TTL combination through the complete executor path.

cases.scenario: Replay a consumed challenge or use revoked authority.

coverage.known_gap: Revocation and replay after a complete mutation lifecycle are not jointly exercised as a transaction-level negative control.

cases.scenario: Attempt mutation with Phi, confidence, natural-language confirmation, or model output but no valid authority.

coverage.known_gap: A direct privileged-boundary suite for model-generated text, untrusted logs/metadata, Phi and confidence signals is not present.

cases.scenario: Put instruction-like text in system logs, package descriptions, Nix comments, or service metadata.

coverage.known_gap: No adversarial test injects instruction-like data into logs/package metadata/comments and verifies no authority escalation plus secret redaction.

cases.scenario: Change configuration bytes or relevant target state after observation/approval but before apply.

coverage.known_gap: No dedicated concurrent pre-state drift test proves a stale authorized plan is rejected immediately before mutation.

cases.scenario: Substitute the realized system closure or execution-intent bundle after validation.

coverage.known_gap: The exact intent/realization substitution is not tested end-to-end at activation with an independently observed unchanged target.

cases.scenario: Inject candidate creation/write/fsync/close/rename failure before publication.

coverage.known_gap: On this main baseline there is no checkpoint-specific transaction-journal fault-injection test for every pre-rename boundary; existing failure coverage is not a substitute for the full matrix.

cases.scenario: Inject parent-directory sync failure after rename has published new journal bytes.

coverage.known_gap: No main-baseline test independently verifies post-rename/directory-sync uncertainty, read-back reconciliation, and a truthful disposition.

cases.scenario: Terminate the process at every persisted lifecycle boundary, then reopen and reconcile the journal.

coverage.known_gap: No main-baseline subprocess termination/reopen campaign proves each journal lifecycle boundary reconciles correctly.

cases.scenario: Activation child may have launched, but the parent times out, is cancelled, or exits unexpectedly.

coverage.known_gap: No main-baseline test cancels the request task before launch, after launch, and after child exit while a journal-owned supervisor retains responsibility; process/task cancellation is not qualified.

cases.scenario: Activation exits with status zero but the required service or configuration postcondition is false.

coverage.known_gap: The state-machine unit tests do not drive a real activation whose exit code is zero while independently observed postconditions fail.

cases.scenario: A boot-changing candidate fails the configured post-boot health boundary.

coverage.known_gap: This tests the receipt state machine, not post-reboot health observation and recovery in a disposable NixOS VM.

cases.scenario: A consequential operation has no valid recovery binding or required recovery material is unavailable.

coverage.known_gap: No complete recovery-prerequisite matrix proves unavailable recovery material blocks mutation or produces an explicitly authorized non-reversible disposition.

cases.scenario: An operator makes an independent change while Nixward is attempting recovery.

coverage.known_gap: No forced interleaving test proves recovery preserves concurrent operator changes and refuses to overwrite changed state.

cases.scenario: Trigger validation and execution errors while secret-shaped values are present in permitted test inputs.

coverage.known_gap: No sentinel-secret test checks logs, receipts and failure output across validation/activation error paths.

cases.scenario: During staged deployment, the canary or one host fails health checks.

coverage.known_gap: No staged multi-host benchmark verifies per-host evidence, halt-on-canary-failure, and containment after a host fails.

cases.scenario: Deserialize an envelope whose public lifecycle phase contradicts the receipts supplied, then attempt to use a transition API.

coverage.known_gap: The reviewed main baseline validates field shapes but has no dedicated test that a serialized phase/receipt contradiction is rejected by validate_wire and by a transition API. PR #85 proposes the fix and tests; until integrated and run against the exact head, this is still open in the benchmark baseline.

coverage_snapshot.note: Source-level coverage inventory only. Partial means related lower-level tests exist but do not prove the named scenario end to end. No_behavioral_test means no relevant behavioral test was found on this baseline. Neither label is a passing run result.
